title: Fountain Craft
description: Replaces the vanilla crafting mechanics at the crafting table, making them more immersive and funny
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad20a76e6e66da66281ef574d9ebc9fd61bec01b.png)

**_Fountain Craft mod_** - is a mod that changes the _vanilla crafting mechanics_ in Minecraft, replacing them with a more immersive and funny system

Now, in the Crafting Table menu, there is no longer a window showing the item you’ll receive; there is only a 3x3 crafting grid. To craft an item, you need to place the items in the correct slots (they will be visually displayed on the block), then exit the crafting table and use Shift + Right-click to craft the item, which will “pop out” of the table _(if there are many items, there will be a small fountain of items) _


****The mod supports all mods (does not conflict with crafting) and JEI****
